rules.case_authorization: OTF program manager written approval before casework
rules.direct_costs: Actual preapproved reasonable necessary allowable costs; no markup
rules.invoice_report: As required by the actual engagement
rules.anti_lobbying_threshold: Actual awarded contract value at least USD 100,000

implementation_choices.labor_time: Whole minutes, original UTC start/end, per-entry half-up rounding to USD cents. Review against the actual signed contract before use.
implementation_choices.retained_sources: Full original bytes, independent content digests and immutable operation history.
implementation_choices.scope_changes: Explicit plan and written approval editions preserve past work bindings.
implementation_choices.invoices: Frozen exact entry selections; source-recorded submission and payment are separate.
implementation_choices.role_rates: Actual awarded rates retained for the life of this workbook. A changed rate schedule needs a new contract workbook with the original retained source; ceiling/end amendments are supported.
